title: Sequential Capacity Probes · Beauty / MC · Table 1
dataset: Amazon Beauty public sequence data; official eSASRec builder; 176,139 train interactions / 22,311 held-out users
model: Paper's deterministic empirical first-order Markov Chain (MC); built and evaluated from scratch on CPU

reference.scope: RecSys 2026 Table 1 Beauty/MC full-catalogue NDCG@10 only; exact four-decimal protocol; not the remaining datasets, factorized methods or GPU transformer runs

installCommand: python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --index-url https://pypi.org/simple numpy==1.26.4 pandas==2.3.3 scipy==1.12.0 rectools==0.13.0 PyYAML==6.0.2 requests==2.34.2

compatibility.note: Official Python 3.10.12 CPU path. The adapter calls the authors' original run_model, MC implementation and official RecTools metric plus their independent metric. It excludes unused Torch/CUDA and therefore does not call the full-matrix verifier, whose global environment contract requires Torch even for MC. Original model, ranking, metric and pinned eSASRec data builder remain unchanged.
